# Vendored code

`segno/` is [segno](https://github.com/heuer/segno) 1.6.6 by Lars Heuer (BSD 3-Clause, see `segno/LICENSE`),
a pure-Python QR code encoder with no dependencies. It is copied here unchanged so that pairing by QR code
needs nothing to be installed. It is only used by `ecoz_pair.py` and `ecoz pair`.
